title: Hue MCP Enhancement - Sprint 1 (Quick Wins)
description: Implement foundational improvements: capability discovery, transition support, better error messages, interactive setup

title: Add zone support for multi-room groupings
description: Implement get_all_zones, create_zone, control_zone tools for managing collections of rooms

title: Implement capability discovery tools
description: Add get_light_capabilities() and get_all_capabilities() tools to show what each light supports (color, temperature, effects, etc.)

title: Add transition support to existing tools
description: Add optional transition_time parameter to brightness, color, and group control tools for smooth transitions

title: Enhance error messages and validation
description: Improve validation with detailed error messages, suggestions, and 'did you mean?' functionality for names

title: Add interactive setup and diagnostics tools
description: Create test_connection(), get_bridge_info(), and setup_bridge() tools for easier configuration and troubleshooting

title: Hue MCP Enhancement - Sprint 2 (Room Intelligence)
description: Implement room-based control: discovery, natural language operations, room management, and zone support

title: Implement room discovery and listing tools
description: Add get_all_rooms() and get_room(room_id/name) tools to discover and display rooms created in Hue app

title: Add natural language room control
description: Implement turn_on_room, turn_off_room, set_room_brightness, set_room_color with fuzzy name matching

title: Implement room creation and management
description: Add create_room, add_lights_to_room, remove_lights_from_room, delete_room tools for full CRUD operations
